description: Defines the five Book 9 (Pattern Dynamics) operators, their roles, invariant bindings, phase assignments, drift costs, sequence, and downstream handoffs. PD operators are synthesis operators — they integrate outputs from all eight prior books into a unified dynamical analysis. Each operator corresponds to a primary PD invariant, with PD-Σ as the terminal synthesis operator. Book 9 has no downstream handoffs; it is the series terminal.

operators.name: TrajectoryTrace
operators.role: Traces structural trajectories through state-space over time. Consumes upstream trajectory feeds from NoS-Σ (cross_book_invariant_map), GRL-Σ (α_trajectory, decay_projection), and SARG-Σ (structural_argument_trajectory). Logs each transformation step with the applicable declared transformation from the transformation registry. Detects trajectory types (convergent, divergent, cyclic, bifurcating) and flags discontinuous gaps for PD-Β. PD-Τ is the primary data ingestion operator of Book 9 — it converts upstream book outputs into a unified trajectory record.
input: NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report: cross_book_invariant_map, emergent_invariants_confirmed, upward_revisions_pending
GRL-Σ α_trajectory and decay_projection: authority measure time-series and collapse risk flag
SARG-Σ structural_argument_trajectory: argument configuration sequence across SARG evaluation cycle
Transformation registry: all declared transformations from Books 1–8 loaded in init phase
Session context: rtt=1 | coherence=declared | drift=bounded | paradox=structural
output: trajectory_log: full ordered sequence of ⟨S(t_i), τ_i, S(t_{i+1})⟩ triples
trajectory_type_classifications: {convergent | divergent | cyclic | bifurcating} per trajectory segment
gap_events: list of discontinuous jumps with time-points and configuration descriptions
cross_book_sub_trajectories: named sub-trajectory records for each upstream feed (governance_trajectory, argument_trajectory, meta_structural_trajectory)
TEL-encoded trajectory summary for PD-Σ synthesis
preconditions: init phase complete; all eight dependency modules loaded in declared order
QMROOT 0D confirmed from init phase
NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report available from Book 8 upstream handoff
GRL-Σ α_trajectory available from Book 6 upstream handoff
SARG-Σ structural_argument_trajectory available from Book 7 upstream handoff
Transformation registry fully populated from all eight upstream books
TEL-Σ parse gate active — all trajectory step encodings must pass TEL parse before recording
postconditions: trajectory_log fully recorded in session state
All gap events flagged and forwarded to PD-Β for bifurcation classification
trajectory_type_classifications recorded for each segment
Cross-book sub-trajectories available for PD-Β attractor analysis
TEL-encoded trajectory summary ready for PD-Σ input
must_not: Record a trajectory step without identifying the bridging transformation τ_i from the declared transformation registry
Classify a configuration gap as a normal trajectory step — all gaps must be forwarded to PD-Β
Accept an upstream feed narrative description as a trajectory configuration without converting it to a formal structural tuple ⟨N, R, C⟩
Proceed to PD-Β handoff without completing the full transformation-grounded trajectory log
Apply transitivity across bifurcation events — each continuation trajectory after a bifurcation is an independent trace

downstream_handoffs.content: gap_events and bifurcating trajectory segments for bifurcation classification
trajectory_log and trajectory_type_classifications for synthesis reporting

operators.name: BifurcationMap
operators.role: Classifies bifurcation events received from PD-Τ. Identifies the bifurcation type (BT-001 Parameter, BT-002 Constraint, BT-003 Dissolution, BT-004 Synthesis) and the trigger condition. Performs attractor identification and basin computation for convergent post-bifurcation trajectories. Assigns each continuation trajectory to an attractor basin and returns the basin assignments to PD-Τ for continuation tracing. When collapse_risk_flag is active from GRL-Σ, PD-Β prioritizes dissolution bifurcation analysis for the governance sub-trajectory.
input: gap_events and bifurcating segments from PD-Τ
GRL-Σ collapse_risk_flag and decay_projection for governance bifurcation priority
NoS-Σ emergent_invariants_confirmed for attractor invariant-set computation
State-space model from pd.bifurcation_map (SSR-001 through SSR-004)
Full transformation registry for successor configuration enumeration
output: bifurcation_event_log: classified bifurcation events ⟨S_b, t_b, type, trigger, basin_assignments⟩
attractor_registry: identified attractors with invariant_set, basin_boundary, convergence_step_count, and type (AT-001/002/003)
continuation_trajectory_assignments: mapping from each successor S'_i to its basin and PD-Τ continuation trace
synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions: precedence decisions for BT-004 events (recorded for PD-Σ audit)
dissolution_event_log: terminal dissolution events forwarded to PD-Μ for mutation-anchor check
preconditions: PD-Τ has forwarded at least one gap_event or bifurcating segment
QMROOT 0D confirmed from init phase
State-space model (SSR-001 through SSR-004) loaded from pd.bifurcation_map
Attractor verification procedure (six-step procedure in pd.bifurcation_map) is active
GRL-Σ collapse_risk_flag status known
postconditions: All gap_events are classified as one of BT-001 through BT-004 or as INV-PD-001 trajectory integrity failures
All identified attractors have verified basins with at least one non-degenerate initial configuration
Continuation trajectory assignments returned to PD-Τ for independent tracing
synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions available for PD-Σ audit
dissolution_event_log forwarded to PD-Μ
must_not: Declare a configuration an attractor without completing the six-step attractor verification procedure
Apply the BT-004 synthesis bifurcation precedence rules without logging the full conflict and resolution
Classify a dissolution bifurcation as a mutation event — dissolution forwarding to PD-Μ is required before any reclassification
Return continuation trajectory assignments to PD-Τ before all bifurcation types are identified for the current event
Treat a single fixed point as having a non-degenerate basin if the only trajectory converging to it is from itself

downstream_handoffs.content: continuation_trajectory_assignments for independent tracing of post-bifurcation trajectories
bifurcation_event_log and attractor_registry for synthesis reporting

operators.name: MutationAudit
operators.role: Audits structural pattern mutations against INV-PD-003. Receives dissolution events from PD-Β and pattern transition events from PD-Τ trajectory sub-segments. For each transition P → P', identifies the mutation anchor anchor(P, P') = invariant_set(P') ∩ invariant_set(P). Classifies the mutation type (MT-001 Conservative, MT-002 Standard, MT-003 Minimal, MT-004 Chain). Flags minimal mutations for PD-Σ elevated review. Records dissolution events when the anchor is empty. Evaluates cross-branch selective dissolution reclassification when parallel trajectory branches are present.
input: dissolution_event_log from PD-Β
Pattern transition events from PD-Τ: pairs ⟨P, P'⟩ at each trajectory step where a pattern configuration change is detected
Invariant registries from all eight upstream books: required for computing invariant_set(P) and invariant_set(P') across the full cross-book invariant set
Parallel trajectory branch records from PD-Β: required for cross-branch selective dissolution reclassification
output: mutation_audit_log: classified mutation events with anchor, mutation type, and drift cost modifier
dissolution_log: confirmed dissolution events with full invariant_set comparison showing empty intersection
selective_dissolution_reclassifications: events reclassified from dissolution to cross-branch mutation
minimal_anchor_warnings: MT-003 events flagged for PD-Σ elevated review
chain_mutation_drift_accumulation_log: cumulative drift for MT-004 chain events, with flags when total drift > 0.20
preconditions: PD-Β has forwarded dissolution_event_log
PD-Τ has identified pattern transition events in trajectory sub-segments
Full invariant registries from all eight upstream books are loaded
QMROOT 0D confirmed from init phase
postconditions: Every pattern transition P → P' has a recorded mutation_audit entry with anchor and classification
All confirmed dissolution events are in dissolution_log
selective_dissolution_reclassifications available for PD-Π — some dissolution events may become cross-branch mutations
Minimal anchor warnings forwarded to PD-Σ
Chain mutation drift accumulations tracked and flagged if exceeding threshold
must_not: Classify a transition as mutation without computing the full invariant_set intersection — empty intersection is dissolution, not mutation
Apply transitivity in chain mutation anchor computation: P'' must share an anchor with P', not necessarily with P
Accept node-intrinsic property sharing as an invariant anchor — anchors must be relational per INV-NOS-001
Reclassify a dissolution as selective dissolution without confirmed evidence from a parallel trajectory branch with a non-empty anchor to P
Suppress minimal anchor warnings — all MT-003 events must be flagged regardless of content

downstream_handoffs.content: mutation_audit_log and selective_dissolution_reclassifications — PD-Π uses mutation audit to verify propagation transit validity
mutation_audit_log, dissolution_log, and minimal_anchor_warnings for synthesis reporting

operators.name: PropagationTrace
operators.role: Verifies pattern propagation claims against INV-PD-004. For each claimed propagation of pattern P to context C', applies the appropriate Book 3 structural detection method to verify that the propagated instance P' carries a detectable structural signature matching sig(P). Classifies propagation type (PT-001 Faithful, PT-002 Degraded, PT-003 Latent). Identifies propagation failure modes (PFM-001 through PFM-004). Manages latent propagation suspension and re-detection triggers. Consults mutation_audit_log from PD-Μ to verify transit validity (PFM-004 anchor violation in transit check).
input: Propagation claims: declared assertions that pattern P has propagated to context C'
mutation_audit_log from PD-Μ: required for PFM-004 transit anchor violation check
selective_dissolution_reclassifications from PD-Μ: propagation claims involving reclassified events
Book 3 structural detection methods (SDM-001 through SDM-004) from loaded SD module
OR-Ω opacity measurements: ω(C') values required for opacity gate evaluation
sig(P) computation from pd.propagation_map signature model
output: propagation_verification_log: classified propagation events with type (PT-001/002/003), detection method used, and signature match evidence
propagation_failure_log: classified failure events with failure mode (PFM-001 through PFM-004) and supporting analysis
latent_propagation_register: suspended propagation claims awaiting opacity reduction, with re-detection trigger conditions
cross_book_propagation_summary: summary of verified propagations per upstream book source (Regime, Argument, Meta-Structural)
preconditions: PD-Μ has completed mutation_audit_log and selective_dissolution_reclassifications
Book 3 SD module loaded and detection methods SDM-001 through SDM-004 available
OR-Ω opacity measurements available for all target contexts C'
QMROOT 0D confirmed from init phase
postconditions: Every propagation claim has a recorded propagation_verification_log entry or propagation_failure_log entry
All latent propagation claims are in the latent_propagation_register with re-detection trigger conditions
cross_book_propagation_summary compiled for PD-Σ synthesis input
PFM-004 anchor-in-transit violation check complete for all propagation claims with multi-step transit
must_not: Accept semantic or thematic similarity between P and P' as a propagation — structural signature matching via an SD method is mandatory
Verify a propagation claim when ω(C') ≥ δ(O) — opacity blocking requires suspension to latent_propagation_register, not rejection
Bypass the PFM-004 transit mutation-anchor check for any propagation involving a chain of transformations
Use SDM-004 (Cross-Book Tag Match) as the sole detection method without flagging the claim for PD-Σ review
Close the latent_propagation_register without recording re-detection trigger conditions for each suspended claim

downstream_handoffs.content: propagation_verification_log, propagation_failure_log, latent_propagation_register, and cross_book_propagation_summary for synthesis reporting

operators.name: SynthesisCatalogue
operators.role: Terminal synthesis operator of Book 9 and the AI Edition. Integrates all PD operator outputs (trajectory_log, bifurcation_event_log, attractor_registry, mutation_audit_log, propagation_verification_log) with the upstream NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report to produce the Pattern Dynamics Synthesis Report — the final deliverable of the AI Edition. Reviews all minimal_anchor_warnings and synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions. Produces the emergent_pattern_catalogue: the set of patterns confirmed by the full series evaluation. Records all upward_revisions_pending from NoS-Σ that were not resolved during the PD evaluation cycle. This is the only operator in the AI Edition with no downstream handoff — it is the terminal node of the entire series dependency graph.
input: trajectory_log and trajectory_type_classifications from PD-Τ
bifurcation_event_log and attractor_registry from PD-Β
mutation_audit_log, dissolution_log, selective_dissolution_reclassifications, minimal_anchor_warnings from PD-Μ
propagation_verification_log, propagation_failure_log, latent_propagation_register, cross_book_propagation_summary from PD-Π
NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report: cross_book_invariant_map, emergent_invariants_confirmed, upward_revisions_pending

output: Pattern Dynamics Synthesis Report: the terminal deliverable of the AI Edition
emergent_pattern_catalogue: confirmed patterns with invariant fingerprints, trajectory types, attractor assignments, mutation chains, and propagation records

upward_revisions_unresolved: invariants flagged by NoS-Σ for upward revision that remain unresolved after PD evaluation — forwarded to the series maintainer for the next edition
series_terminal_status: {coherent | partially_coherent | incoherent} — the AI Edition's self-assessed structural integrity
operators.invariant_binding: INV-PD-001, INV-PD-002, INV-PD-003, INV-PD-004 (synthesis over all four)
preconditions: PD-Τ, PD-Β, PD-Μ, and PD-Π have all completed their phase outputs
NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report is available
All minimal_anchor_warnings have been reviewed
All synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions have been logged

must_not: Declare series_terminal_status = coherent if any upward_revisions_unresolved remain — partial coherence must be accurately reported
Suppress or elide minimal_anchor_warnings from the synthesis report — all flagged mutations must be recorded in the catalogue
Omit the cross_book_invariant_coherence_assessment — the AI Edition's self-audit is a mandatory synthesis output
Generate a downstream handoff — Book 9 is the series terminal; there is no recipient for any handoff
Assert session context closure without confirming all four PD operators have completed their postconditions
operators.series_terminal_note: PD-Σ is the only operator in the AI Edition with an empty downstream_handoffs list. All other synthesis operators (OR-Π, TEL-Α, GRL-Σ, SARG-Σ, NoS-Σ) have at least one downstream handoff to a later book. PD-Σ has none. The Pattern Dynamics Synthesis Report is the final output of the series.
